        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

have hreplace (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (k : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = k then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b k - a k) * 10 ^ k.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = k then b j else a j) * 10 ^ j.1) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9,
            (a j * 10 ^ j.1 +
              if j = k then (b k - a k) * 10 ^ j.1 else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases h : j = k
        · subst j
          simp
          ring
        · simp [h]
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, a j * 10 ^ j.1) +
          (b k - a k) * 10 ^ k.1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp

      rw [hdigits_to_num]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

      simp_rw [hreplace a b]

      (hab : ∀ k : Fin 9,
        7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = k then b j else a j)) :
      7 ∣ digits_to_num a + digits_to_num b := by
    have hs :
        7 ∣ ∑ k : Fin 9,
          digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = k then b j else a j) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro k hk
      exact hab k
    have hdiff :
        (∑ k : Fin 9, (b k - a k) * 10 ^ k.1) =
          digits_to_num b - digits_to_num a := by
      rw [hdigits_to_num]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      ring
    have hsum :
        (∑ k : Fin 9,
          digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = k then b j else a j)) =
          8 * digits_to_num a + digits_to_num b := by
      simp_rw [hreplace a b]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hdiff]
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
    rw [hsum] at hs
    have h7 : (7 : ℤ) ∣ 7 * digits_to_num a :=
      ⟨digits_to_num a, rfl⟩
    have hh := dvd_sub hs h7
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring

have hsum :
        (∑ k : Fin 9,
          digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = k then b j else a j)) =
          8 * digits_to_num a + digits_to_num b := by
      simp_rw [hreplace a b]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hdiff]
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

      _ = u * (x * c) + v * 7 * x := by ring

hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i, dig i * 10 ^ ↑i
hrelation :
  ∀ (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ),
    relation d e ↔
      (∀ (i : Fin 9), d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin 9), 7 ∣ digits_to_num fun j => if j = i then e j else d j
d e f : Fin 9 → ℤ
hrel : relation d e ∧ relation e f
i : Fin 9
hde : ∀ (k : Fin 9), 7 ∣ digits_to_num fun j => if j = k then e j else d j
hef : ∀ (k : Fin 9), 7 ∣ digits_to_num fun j => if j = k then f j else e j
hreplace :
  ∀ (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (k : Fin 9),
    (digits_to_num fun j => if j = k then b j else a j) = digits_to_num a + (b k - a k) * 10 ^ ↑k
pair_dvd :
  ∀ (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ),
    (∀ (k : Fin 9), 7 ∣ digits_to_num fun j => if j = k then b j else a j) → 7 ∣ digits_to_num a + digits_to_num b
hDE : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e
hboth : 7 ∣ (digits_to_num fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) + digits_to_num fun j => if j = i then f j else e j
hp : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ ↑i
hcoprime : ∃ u v, u * 10 ^ ↑i + v * 7 = 1
cancel : ∀ (x c : ℤ), (∃ u v, u * c + v * 7 = 1) → 7 ∣ x * c → 7 ∣ x
q : ℤ
hq : f i - d i = 7 * q
⊢ -(7 * q) = 7 * -q
